summary: AI-first Full-Stack Engineer with hands-on production experience designing and shipping autonomous multi-agent workflows (LangGraph, OpenAI, Anthropic), hybrid RAG systems (Qdrant, Redis, MongoDB), real-time computer vision pipelines (YOLOv8/YOLO11, TensorRT, ONNX), and scalable web applications (Python, FastAPI, React.js, Next.js, Node.js). highlights: Architected an autonomous 15-stage multi-agent pipeline (LangGraph, FastAPI, MongoDB) that converts plain-language prompts (e.g., training a PPE detector within a 1-hour, 16GB VRAM budget) into deployed computer vision models.

Built native Python agent tools for dataset discovery (Roboflow, Kaggle, Hugging Face, GitHub), VRAM estimation, dynamic YOLO config generation, and automated metrics evaluation orchestrated via LangGraph state machines.

Engineered an enterprise RAG supervision and expert chat system powered by OpenAI and Anthropic Claude LLMs, pairing Qdrant vector embeddings with exact JSON snapshot retrieval from Redis and MongoDB.

Implemented self-healing recovery (automatic resolution of CUDA out-of-memory and worker crashes) and a closed-loop hyperparameter optimizer that retrains models until strict quality thresholds are met.
Automated YOLOv8/YOLO11 fine-tuning, evaluation (Precision, Recall, F1, mAP), and multi-target hardware export pipelines (ONNX, TensorRT, TFLite, CoreML, OpenVINO).
Contributed to a shipped, commercial consumer AI security device featuring real-time on-device computer vision and multiple AI-driven alert types with zero unauthorized cloud video storage.
Co-developed LangGraph multi-agent workflows, RAG-based AI supervision, and the platform's core CV Engine for real-time inference across drones, robots, and edge cameras.
Processed and validated 1,000+ daily images and video streams through AI-assisted annotation and ETL workflows while maintaining 95%+ data accuracy.
Collaborated with a global engineering team to establish data quality gates, validation benchmarks, and production documentation standards.
